templates.title: AI Marketplace Monitor
templates.name: ai-marketplace-monitor
templates.description: Watch Facebook Marketplace for the items you want, rate each new listing with AI, and get notified of good deals.
templates.note: Open the web UI on port 8467 and sign in with the Facebook username and password. If Facebook asks for a CAPTCHA or a security code, click Open browser in the web UI. The default configuration needs a UnitySVC API key. See the Docker installation guide.

env.name: FACEBOOK_USERNAME
env.label: Facebook username
env.description: The Facebook account aimm logs in with. Also signs you in to the web UI.

env.name: FACEBOOK_PASSWORD
env.label: Facebook password
env.description: Password of that Facebook account. Also signs you in to the web UI.

env.name: UNITYSVC_API_KEY
env.label: UnitySVC API key
env.description: For the default configuration: the AI that rates listings, and email and phone notifications. Leave empty if you configure other providers.

env.name: TZ
env.label: Time zone
env.description: For the daily digest, e.g. America/Chicago.

env.name: AIMM_WEBUI_AUTH
env.label: Web UI sign-in
env.description: Who signs you in to the web UI. Behind a reverse proxy that signs users in, see the Docker installation guide for the variables each mode needs.

select.text: aimm, with the Facebook username and password
